name: app-conversational-planner-chat-with-quick-reply-chips
title: Conversational Planner with Quick Replies
whatItIs: A feature slide with a cropped phone showing a chat: yellow user bubbles, assistant text and white pill choices (Children, Parents, Work...), a voice input bar, beside a headline 'Organize your life, just by talking'.
whatItMeans: Warm yellow and cream feel personable, and quick-reply chips lower the effort of planning.
techniques: Chip choices instead of open text prompts
Yellow only for the user's messages
Blue mic button as the sole cool accent
Phone cropped off the left/top to enlarge the UI
Small blue eyebrow label above a large light headline

vocabulary.definition: Tappable suggested answers below a chat message.
A device partly out of frame to enlarge the screen.
A small label above a heading.
